item.name: Place or recover the same reviewed bundle order

exec: pm.test('Existing order success envelope', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json())).to.eql(['data']); });

pm.test('Grouped display and no internal metadata', function () { const order = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(order._id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/); pm.expect(order.bundles).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; ['bundleGroups', 'bundleCheckout', 'bundleCardInitialization'].forEach(key => pm.expect(order).not.to.have.property(key)); });
